updater.//: The public key of the release signing key. The private key lives outside the repository — it is the secret TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY of the CI, and it is the only thing that can sign an update.
updater.//2: The manifest of the update. It is the file the release job writes and publishes next to the installers.
updater.//3: The version of the release is read from the signature itself and has to match the version of the manifest. Without this a crafted answer of the endpoint could pair a new version number with the file of an old release and roll the player back to a genuine but outdated build. The signature of every release carries its version, so this holds from the first release.
